spine: 1. 上游化是這個週期的主軸：macaudio 約 3100 行、AVD 約 13000 行且只在下游樹待不到三個月，Thunderbolt 與 USB-PD、SPMI 改動已改採 upstream-first。
2. Apple 的特殊設計逼 Linux 改核心而不只是加 driver：音訊需要大量 ALSA 核心修改，Thunderbolt 打破 Linux 子系統圍繞 Intel 控制器所做的假設，且控制器的 reset 線藏在 PMGR MMIO 範圍裡。
3. 逆向工程的難度隨 Apple 加層而上升：SPTM、Exclaves、Tightbeam，m1n1 靠在 EL1 下開三個 VM 繼續虛擬化 M4 與 M5；M3 轉正但 GPU 仍只畫出三角形。
4. 4 KiB 頁面是遊戲堆疊最大的結構性缺口：macOS 允許行程自選映射粒度，Linux 必須與核心同粒度，muvm 以 VM 補上但付約 20% 與多項限制。
5. P3S 把落差改放在行程切換時寫一次 TCR，文章推論代價實質為零，四款遊戲脫離 muvm 運行，GTA IV 仍不理想。
6. 但 P3S 寫死 16 KiB 主機加 4 KiB 行程、需要 shim 強制啟用、Google 意圖不明，所以團隊決定現在不出貨，避免使用者依賴前景不明的功能。
7. 授權轉向 GPL v2 或更新版本，與上游化、不出貨 P3S 同屬一種取捨：控制自己能維護與保護的範圍。

perspective.mechanism: 報告把商用 Linux 跑在 Apple 矽晶片上的工程成本拆開：Linux 子系統對 Intel 控制器的假設、macOS 允許行程自選頁面粒度而 Linux 不允許、P3S 以每行程記錄粒度並在切換時寫 TCR 來取得 4 KiB、m1n1 以多開 VM 虛擬化 SPTM 與 Exclaves。
perspective.tradeoff: P3S 能讓遊戲脫離 muvm 並省下約 20% 的代價，但寫死頁面大小組合、需要 shim、上游前景不明，團隊因此選擇不出貨；授權由 MIT 轉 GPL 以換取對抄襲與商業化劫持的防護，代價是對 BSD 等參與者較不友善。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師可據此判斷：M3 機器現在不需 EXPERT 旗標但 GPU 尚未可用；Thunderbolt dock 需要的 PCIe 與 DisplayPort tunnelling 尚未支援；x86 遊戲目前實際可用的仍是 muvm；貢獻者要留意授權轉向 GPL v2 或更新版本。

notes.quote: James Calligeros · 2026-11-07
notes.interpretation: 作者署名與發表日期為 2026-11-07。

notes.quote: Well here we are again. Linux 7.3 is out and it’s been an eventful few months, so
notes.interpretation: 這是 Linux 7.3 對應的進度報告。

notes.quote: on Apple Silicon devices is rather special, and required quite a number of core ALSA
notes.interpretation: Apple 的音訊子系統特殊，需要對 ALSA 核心做相當多修改。

notes.quote: The driver and Devicetree changes represent a hefty chunk of our total patchset,
notes.interpretation: macaudio driver 加 Devicetree 改動是整個 patchset 中相當大的一塊。

notes.quote: about 3100 lines.
notes.interpretation: 上一則的 driver 加 Devicetree 改動約 3100 行。

notes.quote: The AVD driver has spent barely 3 months in our downstream
notes.interpretation: AVD driver 在下游樹待了不到三個月就上列表。

notes.quote: are around 13000 lines of code.
notes.interpretation: AVD driver 與相關 Devicetree 改動約 13000 行。

notes.quote: This is our shortest turnaround time yet for a major
notes.interpretation: 作者稱這是主要 SoC 元件至今最短的週轉時間。

notes.quote: SoC component and bodes well for a transition to upstream-first development some time
notes.interpretation: 作者認為這預示日後轉向 upstream-first 開發，措辭是 bodes well，不是已經轉換。

notes.quote: Devicetrees are barebones and only sufficient to boot the SoC to a TTY, however work
notes.interpretation: 初始 Devicetree 很精簡，只夠開到 TTY，更多啟用工作仍在進行。

notes.quote: Also making an appearance on the list this cycle are initial Devicetrees not only for M4 Pro
notes.interpretation: M4 Pro 的初始 Devicetree 上了列表。

notes.quote: and Max devices but also M5 thanks to Yureka
notes.interpretation: M4 Max 與 M5 的初始 Devicetree 同樣上列表，作者歸功於 Yureka。

notes.quote: We have also begun shifting to an upstream-first approach where practical.
notes.interpretation: 在可行處改採 upstream-first。

notes.quote: for Thunderbolt, were all developed upstream-first.
notes.interpretation: TI USB-PD、SPMI 與 Thunderbolt 初始支援都是 upstream-first 開發。

notes.quote: so M3 support is now generally available without the EXPERT flag!
notes.interpretation: M3 支援正式開放，不需 EXPERT 旗標。

notes.quote: Last time, we announced initial support for M3 series machines via the EXPERT flag on
notes.interpretation: 上一份報告透過 EXPERT 旗標開放 M3 初步支援。

notes.quote: We have also made a number of improvements to M3 support, most notably enabling DCP.
notes.interpretation: M3 的改進中最主要的是啟用 DCP。

notes.quote: On top of performance and battery life improvements, this also allows us to enable
notes.interpretation: DCP 帶來效能與續航改善。

notes.quote: sleep on M3 series devices and make the area around the notch useable on the MacBooks!
notes.interpretation: M3 可啟用睡眠，MacBook 瀏海周圍區域可用。

notes.quote: Keep an eye out for m1n1 and kernel updates in the coming days.
notes.interpretation: m1n1 與核心更新預計在報告後幾天內釋出。

notes.quote: While M3 support is now mostly at feature parity with M1 and M2, the very obvious exception
notes.interpretation: M3 與 M1、M2 大致功能對等，明顯例外是 GPU。

notes.quote: GPU was a very significant departure from the models found on M1 and M2 SoCs.
notes.interpretation: M3 GPU 與 M1、M2 的差異非常大。

notes.quote: At XDC this year, Alyssa Millburn,
notes.interpretation: 今年 XDC 上 Alyssa Millburn 等人演講。

notes.quote: Anna Maniscalco and TellowKrinkle
notes.interpretation: 同場演講者還有 Anna Maniscalco 與 TellowKrinkle。

notes.quote: initialise the GPU and for the team to draw a triangle!
notes.interpretation: m1n1 已能初始化 M3 GPU，團隊畫出了三角形。

notes.quote: interesting choices which will require significant engineering
notes.interpretation: Apple 又做了需要大量工程投入的 interesting choices。

notes.quote: effort to integrate into upstream Mesa.
notes.interpretation: 整合進上游 Mesa 需要大量工程投入。

notes.quote: Last time, we teased support for virtualising SPTM-enabled versions of macOS in m1n1, which
notes.interpretation: 上一期預告過 m1n1 虛擬化啟用 SPTM 的 macOS。

notes.quote: as the versions of macOS which support it all require the use of Exclaves.
notes.interpretation: 支援 M5 的 macOS 版本全都要求使用 Exclaves。

notes.quote: Exclaves are small applications running in an isolated environment controlled by the
notes.interpretation: Exclaves 是在 Secure Kernel 控制的隔離環境中執行的小型應用程式。

notes.quote: Secure Kernel. On M5 series SoCs and above, macOS uses them for sensitive tasks
notes.interpretation: M5 系列以上的 macOS 用 Exclaves 處理敏感工作。

notes.quote: the Secure Kernel and its Exclaves via SPTM, using yet another IPC protocol called
notes.interpretation: XNU 透過 SPTM 與 Secure Kernel 及 Exclaves 溝通，用另一套 IPC 協定。

notes.quote: Tightbeam. Much as with SPTM, XNU will panic if it cannot find the running Exclaves.
notes.interpretation: 協定名為 Tightbeam；XNU 找不到執行中的 Exclaves 會 panic。

notes.quote: This is all starting to look very similar in concept to Arm
notes.interpretation: 作者認為概念上開始很像 Arm 的 TrustZone，措辭是 starting to look。

notes.quote: we predict that this will not always be the case. As such, Sven started looking at how we
notes.interpretation: 作者預測繞過 Exclaves 的命令列設定不會一直有效，這是預測。

notes.quote: Secure Kernel and Exclave userspace in another VM next to SPTM and macOS.
notes.interpretation: 把 Secure Kernel 與 Exclave userspace 放進另一個 VM，與 SPTM、macOS 並排。

notes.quote: spawning three VMs in EL1 under m1n1!
notes.interpretation: m1n1 在 EL1 下開出三個 VM。

notes.quote: and reverse engineer macOS on both M4 and M5 series machines.
notes.interpretation: M4 與 M5 系列機器上的 macOS 都可虛擬化並逆向。

notes.quote: such as drawing the “camera in use” indicator to the screen. XNU communicates with
notes.interpretation: Exclaves 用於例如繪製鏡頭使用中指示。

notes.quote: Oh, that worked,
notes.interpretation: 把 Secure Kernel 與 Exclaves 放進另一個 VM 的第一個嘗試成功。

notes.quote: All the way back in January of 2024, we made the mistake
notes.interpretation: 2024 年 1 月，團隊犯了承諾 Thunderbolt 的錯。

notes.quote: of promising Thunderbolt support within the year.
notes.interpretation: 承諾的是年內支援 Thunderbolt。

notes.quote: It’s a mistake we won’t quickly
notes.interpretation: 作者說這個錯不會很快再犯。

notes.quote: almost nothing about Thunderbolt in the two years since,
notes.interpretation: 兩年來幾乎沒談過 Thunderbolt。

notes.quote: Thunderbolt was originally developed by Apple and Intel, with Intel handling the
notes.interpretation: Thunderbolt 原由 Apple 與 Intel 開發，Intel 負責硬體設計製造。

notes.quote: available to anyone who wanted them at a (mostly) reasonable price, no one else
notes.interpretation: Intel 以 (mostly) reasonable 的價格販售控制器，其他廠商沒有自行設計。

notes.quote: the transfer of the standard to the USB-IF
notes.interpretation: 標準移交給 USB-IF，大致與 AMD 等開始自製控制器同時。

notes.quote: to roll their own controllers. Apple is of course no exception.
notes.interpretation: AMD 等公司開始自製控制器，Apple 也不例外。

notes.quote: As part of their push for insourcing most silicon IP, Apple made the choice to
notes.interpretation: Apple 在內製化多數矽智財的推動下自行設計 Thunderbolt 控制器。

notes.quote: design their own Thunderbolt controller before most others.
notes.interpretation: Apple 比多數廠商更早自行設計 Thunderbolt 控制器。

notes.quote: controller is of course a Cortex-M3 running RTKit coupled with a bespoke
notes.interpretation: 控制器是執行 RTKit 的 Cortex-M3。

notes.quote: Thunderbolt/USB4 router. There is one of these for each Thunderbolt-enabled USB-C port
notes.interpretation: 搭配專屬 Thunderbolt/USB4 router，每個支援 Thunderbolt 的 USB-C 埠各一組。

notes.quote: Since Intel supplies every other extant Thunderbolt controller on the market, the
notes.interpretation: 市面上其他 Thunderbolt 控制器全由 Intel 供應。

notes.quote: Thunderbolt subsystem is effectively designed around them. It makes
notes.interpretation: Linux 的 Thunderbolt 子系統實際上圍繞 Intel 控制器設計。

notes.quote: controller breaks a lot of these assumptions. Great.
notes.interpretation: Apple 的控制器打破其中許多假設，後面附帶諷刺的 Great.

notes.quote: The Thunderbolt controller is also oddly coupled to PMGR. The reset line for each
notes.interpretation: 控制器與 PMGR 耦合奇怪，reset 線由 PMGR 控制。

notes.quote: controller is asserted or deasserted by setting and clearing a set of bits in the
notes.interpretation: reset 線靠設定與清除一組位元來拉高或放開。

notes.quote: No other hardware block works quite like this,
notes.interpretation: 沒有其他硬體區塊這樣運作，位元在 PMGR MMIO 範圍中段。

notes.quote: and it took some time to realise that these seemingly random writes to PMGR were
notes.interpretation: 團隊花了一段時間才意識到對 PMGR 的看似隨機寫入不是雜訊。

notes.quote: chore for nearly 5 years in between all of his other incredible work.
notes.interpretation: Sven 為這件工作投入將近 5 年。

notes.quote: sent upstream first (another massive win for us!), we have also pulled it into
notes.interpretation: Thunderbolt patchset 先送上游，也併入下游核心。

notes.quote: our downstream kernel and are now shipping it to users!
notes.interpretation: 下游核心已出貨給使用者。

notes.quote: But there is a catch. Currently, only USB3, XDomain and Thunderbolt Networking are
notes.interpretation: 目前只支援 USB3、XDomain 與 Thunderbolt Networking。

notes.quote: supported. You can plug in USB devices or connect two Thunderbolt computers together
notes.interpretation: 可接 USB 裝置，或把兩台 Thunderbolt 電腦連起來互相 ping。

notes.quote: PCIe and DisplayPort tunnelling
notes.interpretation: PCIe 與 DisplayPort tunnelling 尚未支援。

notes.quote: are not supported. Yet. Watch this space.
notes.interpretation: 兩者尚未支援，後面附 Yet 與 Watch this space。

notes.quote: most Thunderbolt docks
notes.interpretation: 大多數 Thunderbolt dock 需要 PCIe 與 DisplayPort tunnelling。

notes.quote: bake in an assumed 4 KiB memory page size to enable certain performance optimisation.
notes.interpretation: 幾乎所有遊戲內建 4 KiB 頁面大小假設。

notes.quote: x86/amd64 binaries to arm64, and do so fast enough for low-latency gaming. In most
notes.interpretation: 需把 x86/amd64 binary 轉成 arm64 並快到足以低延遲遊玩。

notes.quote: cases, we also need to deal with the Windows API. On top of that, almost all games
notes.interpretation: 多數情況還要處理 Windows API。

notes.quote: translation is hardly a consideration in most cases now;
notes.interpretation: FEX 的轉譯效能與可靠性在多數情況已不太需要考慮。

notes.quote: meaning that FEX now only has to translate the game binaries rather than
notes.interpretation: WINE 的 ARM64EC 成熟，FEX 只需轉譯遊戲 binary。

notes.quote: muvm allows us to spin up a thin VM with DRM Native Context to present
notes.interpretation: muvm 用薄 VM 加 DRM Native Context 向應用程式呈現 4 KiB 頁面大小。

notes.quote: would enable near-native GPU performance from inside the VM. Unfortunately, this
notes.interpretation: muvm 最初假設 DRM Native Context 能讓 VM 內 GPU 效能接近原生。

notes.quote: assumption did not hold. The muvm performance penalty is quite significant for
notes.interpretation: 該假設沒有成立，muvm 效能代價相當大。

notes.quote: a number of reasons, about 20% depending on the workload. Engineering around
notes.interpretation: 代價約 20%，視工作負載而定。

notes.quote: the limitations inherent to using a VM also introduces issues; muvm cannot use
notes.interpretation: 使用 VM 的限制帶來其他問題。

notes.quote: Wayland, has slow I/O performance, and struggles with certain types of input devices.
notes.interpretation: muvm 不能用 Wayland、I/O 慢、某些輸入裝置吃力。

notes.quote: This is one area where macOS has us completely licked.
notes.interpretation: 作者承認這是 macOS 完勝的地方。

notes.quote: between FEX and Rosetta has narrowed, XNU allows userspace processes to map themselves
notes.interpretation: FEX 與 Rosetta 效能差距縮小，XNU 允許使用者空間行程自行映射。

notes.quote: at any page granularity, so all Rosetta needs to do is tell XNU to map 4 KiB pages
notes.interpretation: 可用任意頁面粒度，Rosetta 只需要求 XNU 映射 4 KiB 頁面。

notes.quote: for its child processes. Linux does not have this flexibility. All pages must be
notes.interpretation: 替子行程映射；Linux 沒有這個彈性。

notes.quote: mapped at the same granularity as the kernel.
notes.interpretation: Linux 所有頁面必須與核心同粒度映射。

notes.quote: Windows games working outside of muvm last year, this relied on ugly hacks inside
notes.interpretation: 去年預告過 Windows 遊戲脫離 muvm，但依賴 FEX 內部的醜陋 hack。

notes.quote: FEX which have since been removed in the interests of maintainability and translation
notes.interpretation: 這些 hack 為了可維護性與轉譯正確性已移除。

notes.quote: correctness. Bummer. Even so, compatibility was hit-and-miss, with a lot of (mostly older)
notes.interpretation: 即使當時相容性也時好時壞。

notes.quote: software still refusing to work. Double bummer.
notes.interpretation: 許多（多半較舊的）軟體仍拒絕運作。

notes.quote: Android is currently going through a transition from 4 KiB pages to 16 KiB pages for
notes.interpretation: Android 正從 4 KiB 轉向 16 KiB 頁面。

notes.quote: a variety of reasons. Google Play now requires apps to be built for 16 KiB systems,
notes.interpretation: 原因不止一個；Google Play 現要求應用程式為 16 KiB 系統建置。

notes.quote: and any application updates which do not test successfully on such systems will not
notes.interpretation: 更新後未通過此類系統測試的應用程式不會獲准上架。

notes.quote: be approved for publication on the Play Store. What about applications which are
notes.interpretation: 不會獲准在 Play Store 上架；作者接著問不再更新的應用程式怎麼辦。

notes.quote: Google engineers Kalesh Singh and Frederick Mayle gave a very interesting talk
notes.interpretation: 演講者是 Google 工程師 Kalesh Singh 與 Frederick Mayle。

notes.quote: at Linux Plumbers Conference this year about exactly this. Their solution is simple:
notes.interpretation: 今年在 Linux Plumbers Conference 演講，談的正是這件事。

notes.quote: just fix Linux so that userspace can map 4 KiB pages!
notes.interpretation: 解法是修 Linux 讓使用者空間能映射 4 KiB 頁面。

notes.quote: Their addition to the Android kernel is called P3S, or Per Process Page Size.
notes.interpretation: P3S 全名 Per Process Page Size。

notes.quote: On ARM64 systems, pagetable granularity is controlled by bits set in the Translation Control Registers (TCR).
notes.interpretation: ARM64 頁表粒度由 TCR 的位元控制。

notes.quote: the appropriate bits to the TCR whenever a process with a different pagetable size
notes.interpretation: 切換到頁表大小不同的行程時寫入對應位元。

notes.quote: is switched to. Because this is a single register write, and because this is
notes.interpretation: 這是單一暫存器寫入。

notes.quote: a no-op for “native” page size processes, the performance penalty is effectively
notes.interpretation: 對原生頁面大小行程是 no-op，所以效能代價實質上為零；這是設計推論，文章沒有量測數字。

notes.quote: While this effort is primarily targeted at Android, the patchset mostly rebases
notes.interpretation: P3S 主要針對 Android。

notes.quote: cleanly on top of mainline Linux. What happens if we rebase it on top of our
notes.interpretation: patchset 大致能乾淨 rebase 到主線，團隊接著把它套到 Asahi 樹上。

notes.quote: Battlefront is a very simple Direct3D 9.0 game from 22 years ago.
notes.interpretation: Battlefront 是 22 年前很簡單的 Direct3D 9.0 遊戲。

notes.quote: Star Wars Battlefront (2004) running outside of muvm, with WineD3D
notes.interpretation: Battlefront 2004，搭配 WineD3D，在 muvm 之外執行。

notes.quote: Wolfenstein: The New Order (2014) running outside of muvm
notes.interpretation: Wolfenstein: The New Order 2014，在 muvm 之外執行。

notes.quote: Wolfenstein: The New Order is an extremely well-optimised OpenGL title, and
notes.interpretation: 它是高度最佳化的 OpenGL 遊戲。

notes.quote: pathways to massively reduce the amount
notes.interpretation: 64 位元，走 ARM64EC 路徑，大幅減少 FEX 的工作量。

notes.quote: Something 32-bit so that
notes.interpretation: 下一款特意選 32 位元的遊戲。

notes.quote: FEX and WINE have to work harder. Something that will exercise DXVK too.
notes.interpretation: 讓 FEX 與 WINE 更吃力，也會用到 DXVK。

notes.quote: Grand Theft Auto IV (2008) running outside of muvm, with DXVK
notes.interpretation: GTA IV 2008，搭配 DXVK，在 muvm 之外執行。

notes.quote: Fallout: New Vegas (2010) running outside of muvm, with DXVK
notes.interpretation: Fallout: New Vegas 2010，搭配 DXVK，在 muvm 之外執行。

notes.quote: Bethesda games!
notes.interpretation: Fallout: New Vegas 是 Bethesda 的遊戲。

notes.quote: run essentially flawlessly, with the latter hitting 144+ FPS on an M2
notes.interpretation: Battlefront 與 Wolfenstein 基本上毫無瑕疵，後者達 144+ FPS（M2 Max Mac Studio）。

notes.quote: Max Mac Studio.
notes.interpretation: 機器是 M2 Max Mac Studio。

notes.quote: not fantastic. Performance
notes.interpretation: GTA IV 效能 not fantastic。

notes.quote: is still massively improved over using muvm, and eliminating the use of
notes.interpretation: 效能比使用 muvm 大幅改善。

notes.quote: the VM in general should also eliminate a few classes of bugs. Debugging
notes.interpretation: 不用 VM 應該能消除幾類 bug，措辭是 should。

notes.quote: the GPU driver should also be much easier with this approach.
notes.interpretation: 除錯 GPU driver 應該容易許多，措辭是 should。

notes.quote: As always there is a catch, and unfortunately it’s a big one.
notes.interpretation: 作者稱這個代價很大。

notes.quote: The current solution is hard-coded for 16 KiB hosts and 4 KiB processes
notes.interpretation: 目前方案寫死 16 KiB 主機與其上的 4 KiB 行程。

notes.quote: adding pagesize-specific kludges to the
notes.interpretation: 在核心記憶體管理的核心程式碼加入針對特定頁面大小的 kludge。

notes.quote: is not appropriate upstream. We are unsure if Google intends to generalise
notes.interpretation: 這在上游不適當；團隊不確定 Google 是否打算一般化。

notes.quote: this approach and upstream it, or if this is going to stay an Android-only patchset.
notes.interpretation: 也不確定是否會一直是只屬於 Android 的 patchset。

notes.quote: As such, we do not want to ship this in our downstream tree and have folks
notes.interpretation: 團隊不想把它放進下游樹。

notes.interpretation: 避免使用者在這種不確定下開始依賴它。

notes.quote: It also requires userspace integration. P3S works by checking the binary
notes.interpretation: P3S 還需要使用者空間整合，靠檢查 binary。

notes.interpretation: P3S 在 Google 用法中是 fallback 機制。

notes.interpretation: 針對對齊 4 KiB 的應用程式；現代 arm64 binary 對齊 64 KiB。

notes.quote: as this guarantees compatibility with systems of all native pagesizes. Thus,
notes.interpretation: 64 KiB 對齊可保證與所有原生頁面大小的系統相容。

notes.quote: a shim is required to force P3S on. The shim triggers P3S, and any
